retrieval_skill.name: layered_regime_validation
retrieval_skill.description: Validate forecasts by separating observation reliability from latent process behavior, confirming both data validity and the active physical regime.
retrieval_skill.applicability: When recent anomalies may reflect measurement failure while the underlying process has entered a distinct forecastable regime.
retrieval_skill.query_strategy: Search first for evidence that the observation fault ended before the forecast origin, then independently retrieve documentation of the latent process regime and its expected trajectory across the forecast window.
retrieval_skill.verification_rule: Accept initialization only when provenance-supported evidence confirms valid observations at the origin and separately supports a process regime that overlaps the full forecast horizon; preserve exact-quote and temporal-window requirements.

decision_skill.name: post_change_regime_stability
decision_skill.description: Prefer a candidate assumption that explicitly verifies a sufficiently established and internally stable post-change regime over one that merely extrapolates a recent slope.
decision_skill.applicability: When a structural change is detectable and enough subsequent observations exist to assess whether the new regime has stabilized.
decision_skill.decision_rule: Identify the latest robust change point, require an adequate post-change sample, measure slope with an outlier-resistant estimator, and select the assumption only if slope variation within that segment remains below a predefined stability tolerance.
decision_skill.failure_condition: Do not use when the change point is ambiguous, the post-change segment is too short, telemetry validity is unresolved, slope stability fails, or the assumed regime does not cover the forecast horizon.
